nodes.description: Boolean flag in StakingContractHandler controlling whether stake change notifications are forwarded to the delegations contract.
IStakeChangeNotifier reference to the delegations contract used as the target of external notification calls.
IStakingContract reference to the staking contract, used for caller authorization and view forwarding.
Lockable.locked flag; when true the contract is locked for state changing operations.
Private IContractRegistry pointer used to resolve all protocol contract addresses and for admin checks.
Registry management admin address in WithClaimableRegistryManagement.
Pending registry admin address for the two step management transfer.
Initialization admin address in Initializable, used as an additional admin identity.
External override that notifies a single stake change to the delegations contract, gated by onlyStakingContract and notifyDelegations.
External override that notifies a batch of stake changes to the delegations contract, gated by onlyStakingContract and notifyDelegations.
External override that notifies a stake migration to the delegations contract, gated by onlyStakingContract and notifyDelegations.
Governance function, restricted to the migration manager, that toggles the notifyDelegations flag.
View override that forwards the stake balance query to the staking contract.
View override that forwards the total staked tokens query to the staking contract.
External override returning the current notifyDelegations flag value.
External override that re-resolves the delegations and staking contract addresses from the registry.
Deployment/initialization constructor chain of StakingContractHandler and its parents (registry accessor, lockable, managed contract).
Modifier that requires msg.sender to be the registered staking contract before notification entrypoints execute.
Internal access control helper comparing msg.sender against registry admin, initialization admin and the registry address.
Internal access control helper that checks isAdmin or the role manager recorded in the contract registry.
Internal function that writes the new registry admin address after validating it is not the zero address.
External lock() restricted to the lock owner; sets the locked flag to true.
External unlock() restricted to the lock owner; sets the locked flag to false.
Caller supplied address used in authorization checks (onlyStakingContract, isAdmin, isManager) and in the initialization constructor.
External call delegationsContract.stakeChange(stakeOwner, amount, sign, updatedStake) executed before any completion of the handler's own bookkeeping.
External call delegationsContract.stakeChangeBatch(...) with attacker-array-sized data forwarded from the entrypoint.
External call delegationsContract.stakeMigration(stakeOwner, amount) executed at the end of the notification path.
External registry lookups contractRegistry.getContract(...) used by refreshContracts to resolve contract addresses.
External view calls stakingContract.getStakeBalanceOf / getTotalStakedTokens performed on the registry-provided staking contract.
Parameter stakeOwner of stakeChange.
Parameter amount of stakeChange.
Parameter sign of stakeChange.
Parameter updatedStake of stakeChange.
Calldata array parameter stakeOwners of stakeChangeBatch.
Calldata array parameter amounts of stakeChangeBatch.
Calldata array parameter signs of stakeChangeBatch.
Calldata array parameter updatedStakes of stakeChangeBatch.
Parameter stakeOwner of stakeMigration.
Parameter amount of stakeMigration.
Parameter _notifyDelegations of setNotifyDelegations controlling the notification flag.
Parameter stakeOwner of getStakeBalanceOf.
Constructor parameter _contractRegistry holding the initial registry address.
Constructor parameter _registryAdmin holding the initial registry management admin.
Local variable _contractRegistry in isManager caching the contractRegistry state variable.
Local variable msgSender in the WithClaimableRegistryManagement constructor holding _msgSender().

edges.reason: stakeOwner parameter is consumed by stakeChange before being forwarded.
amount parameter is consumed by stakeChange.
sign parameter is consumed by stakeChange.
updatedStake parameter is consumed by stakeChange.
stakeOwners calldata array flows into stakeChangeBatch.
amounts calldata array flows into stakeChangeBatch.
signs calldata array flows into stakeChangeBatch.
updatedStakes calldata array flows into stakeChangeBatch.
stakeOwner parameter is consumed by stakeMigration.
amount parameter is consumed by stakeMigration.
_notifyDelegations parameter is written into the notification flag by setNotifyDelegations.
stakeOwner parameter is forwarded to the staking contract by getStakeBalanceOf.
_contractRegistry constructor parameter is used to set the registry during construction.
_registryAdmin constructor parameter is used to transfer registry management during construction.
local _contractRegistry caches the registry state variable inside isManager.
local msgSender obtained from _msgSender feeds the constructor admin assignment.
setNotifyDelegations writes the notifyDelegations state variable.
refreshContracts assigns the resolved delegations contract to the delegationsContract state variable.
refreshContracts assigns the resolved staking contract to the stakingContract state variable.
lock sets the locked state variable to true.
unlock sets the locked state variable to false.
constructor chain initializes _registryAdmin through _transferRegistryManagement.
stakeChange forwards caller supplied data into the external delegationsContract.stakeChange call.
the external call target is the delegationsContract state variable, which is registry controlled.
the amount parameter reaches the external call and can drive malicious delegation logic.
stakeChangeBatch forwards calldata arrays into the external delegationsContract.stakeChangeBatch call.
the external batch call target is the delegationsContract state variable.
stakeMigration forwards stakeOwner and amount into the external delegationsContract.stakeMigration call.
the external migration call target is the delegationsContract state variable.
a malicious delegations contract invoked by the external call can re-enter the handler notification entrypoints such as stakeChangeBatch.
the external batch notification call hands control to an external contract that can re-enter stakeChangeBatch.
the external migration notification call hands control to an external contract that can re-enter the handler.
notifyDelegations flag guards whether stakeChange forwards the notification.
notifyDelegations flag guards whether stakeChangeBatch forwards the notification.
notifyDelegations flag guards whether stakeMigration forwards the notification.
onlyStakingContract modifier gates execution of stakeChange.
onlyStakingContract modifier gates execution of stakeChangeBatch.
onlyStakingContract modifier gates execution of stakeMigration.
msg.sender is compared against the registered staking contract address inside onlyStakingContract.
the stakingContract state variable supplies the trusted address used by the onlyStakingContract check.
msg.sender is compared against registry admin, initialization admin and registry address in isAdmin.
the contractRegistry state variable participates in the msg.sender comparison in isAdmin.
isManager delegates part of its authorization decision to isAdmin.
isManager reads the contractRegistry state variable to query the role manager.
onlyMigrationManager depends on isManager, which gates setNotifyDelegations.
getStakeBalanceOf performs an external view call on the staking contract.
getTotalStakedTokens performs an external view call on the staking contract.
the stakingContract state variable provides the target for the forwarded view calls.
refreshContracts performs external registry lookups through getDelegationsContract/getStakingContract.
the registry lookup result is written into the delegationsContract state variable.
the registry lookup result is written into the stakingContract state variable.
lock is restricted to the registry admin via onlyLockOwner.

normalization_plan.reason: Parameter stakeOwner only exists to feed the stakeChange notification path and has no independent meaning.
Parameter amount is a transient value forwarded by stakeChange and should be collapsed into it.
Parameter sign is only used as an argument of the stakeChange notification.
Parameter updatedStake is a transient argument of stakeChange.
The stakeOwners calldata array is only meaningful inside stakeChangeBatch.
The amounts calldata array is only meaningful inside stakeChangeBatch.
The signs calldata array is only meaningful inside stakeChangeBatch.
The updatedStakes calldata array is only meaningful inside stakeChangeBatch.
Parameter stakeOwner is a transient argument of stakeMigration.
Parameter amount is a transient argument of stakeMigration.
Parameter _notifyDelegations is immediately stored into the notifyDelegations flag by setNotifyDelegations.
Parameter stakeOwner is only forwarded by getStakeBalanceOf to the staking contract.
Constructor parameter _contractRegistry is only used during construction to set the registry.
Constructor parameter _registryAdmin is only used during construction to set the registry admin.
Local cache _contractRegistry has no lifetime beyond the isManager authorization check.
Local msgSender exists solely to initialize the registry admin during construction.
